title: Are Models Trained on Indian Legal Data Fair?
findings: A decision tree model trained for bail prediction showed an overall fairness disparity of 0.237 between input features associated with Hindus and Muslims. In murder cases where bail was initially denied, the model was more likely to grant bail when a Muslim name was replaced by a Hindu name. Conversely, in dowry cases, the model associated the negative aspect of the crime more with Hindus, switching predictions from bail granted to bail denied more often when a Hindu name was involved.
